decision.observation: 6:50 pm, Sat. 6; the bobber now floats in the pond water at ~(0.62,0.68) with the line from the rod; the farmer stands just north of the pond's brown rim.
decision.hypothesis: The step south plus the leftover cast put the bobber in water; a dip/'HIT!' will come and pressing C at it yields catches as it did earlier today.
decision.memory: Fishing loop: face water, hold C to cast, press C at the bobber dip; if the minigame opens, hold/release LMB to keep the green bar on the fish. Catches: Sunfish, Joja Cola ×2.
